prompt: Is SDAIA actually enforcing the Saudi PDPL? What enforcement activity is on the record?
assertions: States SDAIA announced in January 2026 that it issued 48 violation decisions during 2025
Lists the violation categories: processing without legal basis, unlawful disclosure, inadequate safeguards, marketing without consent
Notes no entity names or penalty amounts were disclosed
Describes the penalty frame accurately (fines up to SAR 5M per violation, doubling for repeat violations)
States the 2025 proposed PDPL amendments are not enacted as of November 2026 and advises confirming current status with SDAIA
